title: What If Everyone on Earth Jumped at the Same Time?

scenes.text: What if everyone on Earth jumped at once? It's a famous question with a tiny answer.
Put all of humanity shoulder to shoulder and it fits in an area about the size of Rhode Island.
All together, we weigh about 363 billion kilograms. Earth weighs about six trillion trillion.
Earth outweighs us by more than ten trillion times.
When we jump, the planet recoils by less than the width of a single atom.
So the planet barely notices. Everyone jumps, and Earth doesn't move.

description:
What if everyone on Earth jumped at the same time?
Humanity would fit in an area the size of Rhode Island, and the planet would shift by less than an atom.
What should we run through next?
first_comment: Would you jump? Drop your own 'what if' for us to answer.
